dialogues.speaker: Shouta
dialogues.text: We gave two offerings to the shrine, right? However, the deity hasn't responded to me yet.

dialogues.speaker: Shouta
dialogues.text: I went to have a look, and offerings weren't there anymore...

dialogues.speaker: Shouta
dialogues.text: But when we went there the first time, the deity granted a part of my wish after accepting my offerings...

dialogues.speaker: Shouta
dialogues.text: So, I was thinking... Someone... Or something might've stolen the offerings before the deity could accept them.

dialogues.speaker: Shouta
dialogues.text: If that's the case, then I'm in trouble. I might not be able to give offerings again...

dialogues.speaker: Shouta
dialogues.text: If I'm too persistent with my wishes, even deities will grow impatient.

dialogues.speaker: Shouta
dialogues.text: Please help me! Please come with me to the shrine outside the city and take a look!
